messages:
claire.partnerships: Kicking off marketplace onboarding thread for AWS/GCP/Azure + optional hardware partner (edge box). Need: publisher IDs, final SKU slugs, short legal blurbs, and a packaged manifest per vendor. Partner preview in two weeks.

jia.product: SKU shortlist: `redwood-core-saas` (14d trial, metered), `redwood-core-pro` (monthly + overage), `redwood-edge-box` (one-time + install). Recommend bundle SKU `redwood-core-bundle` that pairs SaaS + Edge.

claire.partnerships: Good. Preference: trial no-CC. @tom.legal any blockers? Also need short listing copy (<=80 chars) and hero art.

tom.legal: No-CC trials OK with safeguards. Will add abuse clause + opt-in billing prompt before trial ends. Preparing vendor-specific snippets: AWS private-offer clause, GCP SaaS T&C note, Azure managed-app support blurb. Will localize EN/DE/FR.

riley.ops: Ops status: AWS sandbox publisher: RBW-AWS-SBX-29 (ready). GCP publisher request submitted (pinged portal). Azure tenant verification pending; I have the MS contact. Webhook endpoints we need to expose: `/marketplace/provision` and `/marketplace/entitlements`. Make sure partner portals can reach them.

jia.product: Manifest example (pseudo):
```
offerId: redwood-inference-2026
publisherId: <vendor-id>
skus: [redwood-core-saas, redwood-core-pro, redwood-edge-box]
metadata: { eu_data_only: false, supports_vpc: true }
```

claire.partnerships: Marketing/design: can we get hero + 10s GIF + 60-char headline by end of week? Suggest headline: "Predictable inference. Marketplace-ready."

design-team: On it. Will post assets to the marketing channel and attach PNG + GIF.

tom.legal: One compliance note: AWS requires explicit data residency toggle if we offer EU-only processing. Add `eu_data_only` metadata and short privacy blurb in each vendor listing. Also include DPA link for EU customers.

jia.product: I'll add a one-line billing copy: "14-day trial, then $0.00035 per token unit (10k tokens = $3.50)." Will add example invoice lines in the PR.

riley.ops: I'll run a private-offer flow in the AWS sandbox tonight and post manifest validation results. If schema mismatches, will open infra ticket.

claire.partnerships: Action items: 1) @tom.legal finalize vendor T&C + privacy blurbs (due Wed 12:00 UTC). 2) @jia.product lock SKU slugs + billing copy + example invoice lines (due Tue EOD). 3) @riley.ops complete AWS sandbox private-offer test and GCP manifest submission (due Tue 23:59 UTC). 4) @design-team deliver hero + GIF (due Fri). Follow-up sync next Wed 9am PT in #partnerships.

riley.ops: Noted. Will paste sandbox logs here. If Azure tenant clears earlier, ping me to finish activation.

claire.partnerships: Thanks all :thumbsup:  If anyone hits blockers, drop updates here or DM.
